column1: # Trade routes (docs/design/gameplay.md §17.2; user 2026-11-16). GM-tunable (trade-routes.rules); these are the defaults.

column3: note
stamina an hour of budget gives ("按每小时100算吧"); an hour more on the road for each this much gained
stamina walking a path
...this share of it once both ends are cleared ("移动时体力值只需1/3")
stamina a fight takes
a supply point won from its guards gives this once ("抄了路匪恶霸的宝库")
passing a cleared one gives this, once each time out ("合理征收一定的粮草")
heroes in a team at most
a hero's men at most: level x this ("按等级*100 + 统率*10 + 魅力 * 5 + 其余之和")...

a hero (or an enemy column's general) strikes the enemy column it counters (when one is in front) with chance points / (points + this), points from its attributes (aimAttrs: the content's, tradeRoutes.weighAim; user 2026-11-18: "优先砍克制的，但如果英雄属性太低，则又有概率瞎砍")
...+ each attribute x this, or its own factor (the content plugin's, tradeRoutes.weighAttributes: leadership 10, charm 5)
hours of budget to choose from ("1/8/24/72小时")
a strike deals pace x attack² / (attack + defence), attack as the column's hp left says: fights of several rounds
chance a strike misses
a strike's damage varies by up to this share either way (0.15: 85%-115%)
rounds at most: then the attackers give up
of the blows a column takes, its hero bears this share and the men the rest (user 2026-11-20: "固定最多40%的伤害由英雄承担")
each hero who won a fight has this chance of an epiphany ("运气好时还可以顿悟获得自由属性点")...
...giving this many free points...
...to this many
a deal takes floor + (minutes - floor) / (1 + trade speed): 8 hours at a level-1 trade post ("固定8小时")...
...never below this ("最后无限趋近于3分钟")
trade speed % a trade post level gives up to level upTo ("二十级到1小时")...
...then each level x this (compounded: "复利吧，显示起来也方便"; level 40 about 4 minutes)
what a deal loses before any route's help ("基础损耗20%"): the player pays the more of what it gives
goods a merchant has a day, drawn by weight (those always there besides; "随机刷新")
